info.name: Retrieves the Persistent Identifier (PID) for a given prefix and suffix.

params.name: prefix
params.description: The PID prefix. Limited to the values provided by the API.

params.name: suffix
params.description: The PID suffix of a project or a resource, represented as a GUID.

items.docs: Retrieves the Persistent Identifier (PID) for a given prefix and suffix.

info.name: Sends an inquiry to the owner of the given PID.

params.name: prefix
params.description: The PID prefix of a project or a resource to validate

params.name: suffix
params.description: The PID body of a project or a resource to validate

items.docs: Sends an inquiry to the owner of the given PID.

params.name: IncludeProjects
params.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to include projects when retrieving pid information.

params.name: IncludeResources
params.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to include resources when retrieving pid information.

params.name: IncludeDeleted
params.description: Gets or sets a value indicating whether to include deleted pid information.

params.name: PageNumber
params.description: Gets or sets the desired page number. Should be greater than or equal to 1. Default is 1.

params.name: PageSize
params.description: Gets or sets the desired page size. Should be between 1 and the maximum allowed page size (50). Default is 10.

params.name: OrderBy
params.description:
Gets or sets the field name used for ordering the results.
The order is constructed by an order string.
Use the property followed by "asc" or "desc" and separate properties by commas. Default is asc.
Can be used like this: "propertyA asc, propertyB desc".

info.name: Responds with the HTTP methods allowed for the endpoint.

items.docs: Responds with the HTTP methods allowed for the endpoint.
